title: Personal settings
subtitle: Manage your profile and connected sign-in methods.
profileDescription: Your name, job title, phone and language are used across the CRM.
saveFailed: Could not save your profile. Please try again.
loadFailed: Could not load your settings. Please refresh the page.
casdoorDescription: Link a Casdoor identity to sign in with SSO. Linking never creates or switches a CRM account.
notLinkedHint: You can sign in with Casdoor and attach it to this account, even if the Casdoor email is different.
syncButton: Sync name and title from Casdoor
linkFailed: Casdoor linking failed. Please try again.
linkStateExpired: The link request expired. Open Personal settings and click Link again.
linkSessionLost: Your CRM session was lost. Sign in again, then retry the link.
linkTokenFailed: Casdoor rejected the code exchange. Ask an administrator to check CASDOOR_CLIENT_SECRET.
linkProfileFailed: Could not read your Casdoor profile. Ask an administrator to check the app's OIDC scopes.
linkConflict: That Casdoor account is already linked to another CRM user.
alreadyLinked: This CRM account is already linked to a different Casdoor account. Unlink it first.
linkPendingHint: This Casdoor account is waiting for CRM admin approval. A super admin reviews requests in Setup → Users.
linkRejectedHint: This Casdoor link was rejected by an administrator. Contact them or try another account.
linkRevokedHint: This Casdoor link was revoked. A new link requires admin approval again.
linkDomainNotAllowed: This Casdoor email domain is not allowed for CRM access.
linkAccountTypeNotAllowed: This Casdoor account type is not allowed for CRM access. Use your work account.
linkOrganizationNotAllowed: This Casdoor organization is not allowed for CRM access.
unlinkFailed: Could not unlink Casdoor. Please try again.
unlinkConfirm: After unlinking you can only sign in with your password. Continue?
noPasswordHint: To unlink, sign in once with your password or set one on the change-password page first.
syncDone: Name and title imported from Casdoor.
syncFailed: Could not import the Casdoor profile. Please try again.
